The next two slides are about places where you must stop, no matter what: next to a school bus that is loading or unloading children with its signals on. Never pass a school bus while it loads or unloads. Flashing red signals and the extended stop sign both command a full stop. And the stop applies from either direction, unless a separation or median divides the road.
